fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-08-21, a loan agent collected Rs. 1,20,000 from the complainant for approving a personal loan and then stopped answering calls. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-08-20 around 15:30 hrs. Babu Selvam submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000442. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Dinesh Subramani, using the number 9000000212. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100039. Praveen Balan (9000000446) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Potentially relevant material referenced includes transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, residential colony, transaction record, afternoon, witness, receiving account, mobile number
